title: Matières modulaires des 30 planètes de guerre des clans
sourcePolicy: Unmodified native generated PNGs. Prompts and visual reviews in docs/planet-materials-v101.
runtimePolicy: 512 square WebP, quality 88, alpha quality 100. Resampling/encoding only; source PNGs unchanged.
mapping: World-space triplanar mirrored sampling; exact V97 landmass geometry. Native tile edges are not certified seamless.
atmosphere: Artistic Rayleigh/Mie-style limb and twilight approximation in a separate shader layer, not a physically measured scattering simulation.
